Class Manager.Page

java.lang.Object
Manager.Page
Direct Known Subclasses:
EmployeePage, InventoryPage, MenuPage, OrderingTrendsPage, ProductUsagePage, ReorderPage
Enclosing class:
Manager
public abstract static class Manager.Page extends Object
Represents a page within the Manager interface. Provides shared access to the database, window, table, and status bar.
